data.summary: “He’s So Mad at Me!!?” has pulled 18,172,600 views at ~33,920/hour — well above a normal upload. It reads as a tutorial whose strongest lever is engagement. The breakdown below frames the rest as likely contributors, not proven causes.

why_trending.detail: An unusually high like-to-view ratio suggests strong resonance, a signal the algorithm likely reads as a reason to keep distributing it.
The topic taps a timely, high-interest subject, so audience intent is likely already searching for and engaging with it.
A high-contrast thumbnail with a clear focal subject likely lifts the initial tap rate against a busy Shorts feed.
The first second of the title promises a clear, specific payoff, which likely earns the early swipe-through that short-form distribution rewards.

outlier_insight.headline: **3.4× their own median** — **captions** is what broke the pattern.
outlier_insight.pattern_break: Their other clips top out near **6.7M** (e.g. “The Principal Said Keep His Lunch Reasonable!!?”); this one **3.4×'d** their median. The break: it leans harder on **captions** than their usual tutorial uploads.
outlier_insight.why_it_spread: Spread via **early-engagement velocity** the algorithm caught and amplified.
outlier_insight.steal_this: **Burned-in captions** carry it sound-off — the turn lands on screen, not just in audio.
outlier_insight.replicability_note: the spike came from timing as much as content.
